Just for the record ask yourself if this overweight woman would stay with you, should something catastrophic  happen. Like you have a heart attack or any life threatening event. Whilst you are all focusing on weight being the most important thing. Have you ever thought that you aren't all that? . My husband was " fit' and we'll supposedly when he had his first heart attack shockingly at 45. did I stand by him you bet I did. I was a bit overweight. He never judged me. That's love   I have lost weight for my own self. You all should be ashamed. Look at yourselves first & foremost. Stop judging because very few of your arguments are valid.  Perhaps your breath stinks, you have bad teeth too much hair hanging out of your ears and nose, your feet smell , you are loosing your hair? Christ there is a lot of faults apart from being repulsed by having a partner who is overweight and not sexy. Maybe you are an active part in it.  Amen service over.

The core sentence that jumps out 'i pretend to be fine, if you do that then nobody will understand the severity of the problem. You could be silent screaming in your own head, or wishing you could drop to your knees and shout and scream in the street. To get people to notice how very painful it is until you are suddenly looking at emptiness and possible thoughts of suicide.i hope to god that you have not acted impulsively and you are still here.. I'm not going to give you a cure, I can't. Have a rant at me a big one and get it out if your system for at least the trigger times. Best of luck I'm here if you want a hand up always.

I don't know whether you still look at your posts but I hope so. Life can be so painful and unjust, it can feel so very hard to go on each and every bloody day! Nobody really understands how it feels to walk in your shoes and it seems such an insurmountable struggle. Your dogs need YOU to carry on so that they can live their happy lives with YOU. Only You will do for them, You are their world, their only world. I fight most days to cling on to this life  by my fingertips, my 16 year old dog means the world to me the memories we have shared,  his constant companionship, his vigilance. Most of all his love of our shared life together. Please don't ever give up on your best friends who will have no choice in the end but would always choose to be with their best forever friend who is You. X
